title: Clearifi AI helps you verify AI answers instead of relying on a single model.
description:
Clearifi AI helps you verify AI answers instead of relying on a single model.

Ask one question, and it compares responses from leading AI models side by side, highlighting where they agree, where they differ, and surfacing a consensus score to help you judge the reliability of the result. It's a useful way to catch inconsistencies and get more confidence before acting on AI-generated information.

If you're using AI for research, coding, or important decisions, this is a tool worth adding to your workflow.
